quest.title: The Artist By the Moon's Side (II)
quest.description: The Damselette is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong, Columbina? You look like something's troubling you.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Do you have any paint with you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In the mood for more painting, huh? Looks like you got most of the paint on yourself, though... How did that happen?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Maalaus left for a bit and came back like this. I anticipate this paint will take quite some time to wash off.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, maybe Maalaus ran into trouble while out searching for inspiration...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, this isn't a bad look at all. Very fitting for an artist!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and about the paint... We just need to give Maalaus colorful things, right? Like last time?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, now that's one happy kuuhenki. Maalaus must've hit on some really good ideas... Something fun and upbeat for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's find some warm, happy colors this time!

talks.objective: Give the kuuhenki some objects with vivid colors

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! There she goes, painting away already!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahem... Dear judges, prepare to be amazed! What kind of masterpiece will our talented kuuhenki artist bring us toda—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You're done already!? Paimon didn't even get to finish her intro...!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, let's see here. Oh! Another drawing of Columbina. No surprise there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is that... a forest somewhere in Nod-Krai? There are so many little animals!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: I'm afraid... you would have to go back to the time before I left the Frostmoon Scions to see a scene like this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, Paimon's so jealous! Did cute little animals really gather around you like that?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Yes, most of them were drawn to the kuuvahki around me. They felt safe curling up next to me like that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's so awesome! You could pet them all you wanted without them running away!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Hm... I would say the chic badgers were the nicest to pet. They're the ones with the big, fluffy tails.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The fur on a rimehorn deer's neck is quite soft as well. It makes a very comfortable pillow.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Which do you prefer?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, we don't really have the same kind of experience to go off of...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, Paimon would probably choose to pet a chic badger's tail.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Chic badgers can be quite timid. If you want to pet them, they need to feel safe first.

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Ah... But I would exercise caution, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why? Do they... bite, or something? P—Paimon promises to be super gentle...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: No. I'm referring to danger from above.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Danger from above...?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Yes... Longplume ibises often hunt little animals like these. I had to issue them a warning to get them to stop going after the kuuhenki.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're just telling Paimon this now!? It's a miracle she hasn't been carried off yet!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Ah... Then, the next time I see one, I'll advise them that you are off limits as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Next time? No, you need to find one right now, or Paimon'll be too scared to even fly out that door!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Ah, I see. In that case, I will be sure to tell them that Paimon is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! They can't just go around snatching up people's travel companions!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: The little one... seems strangely curious about the idea of Paimon being carried off by a longplume ibis.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't even think about painting a picture like that...

choices.text: The greatest travel guide in Teyvat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Paimon's glad you see it that way, but... They probably don't even know what a "travel guide" is.

choices.text: A food source that would just upset their stomachs.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, don't even put that thought in their heads! What if they try their luck!?

choices.text: Just looking at it makes me feel happy.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: *sigh*... I really would like to pet the little animals again.
